excerpt.zh:
如果您想要开发被£science_ship£科研船发现的资源，那么您需要派遣£construction_ship£工程船执行相关任务。

点击恒星基地选择船坞界面。再在几个选项中选择工程船。

注意您需要足够的£alloys£合金才能开始建造这些舰船。
excerpt.en:
We will need a £construction_ship£ Construction Ship if we are to exploit the resources that are discovered by our £science_ship£ Science Ship.

Click on our Starbase and select the Shipyard tab, then select Construction Ship from among the available choices.

点击恒星基地选择船坞界面。再在几个选项中选择工程船。

注意您需要足够的£alloys£合金才能开始建造这些舰船。
texts.en:
We will need a £construction_ship£ Construction Ship if we are to exploit the resources that are discovered by our £science_ship£ Science Ship.

Click on our Starbase and select the Shipyard tab, then select Construction Ship from among the available choices.

Note that you will need to have amassed enough £alloys£ Alloys to afford the Ship before its construction can begin.
